about: INS reference cells for the PA-00 answer records. Run with scripts/fetch-ins-reference-cells.py; output is retained evidence, not corpus data. Year ranges extended on 2026-10-12 to what INS publishes now.

queries.purpose: Q1/Q4 denominator: INS total per county and national, to verify the summed age x sex x residence partition and explain the 2025 national gap
Q2: average net monthly earnings, all activities, both sexes, per county
Q3: registered unemployment rate, both sexes, per county
Q4 numerator: INS total stays per county, to verify the summed type x tourist partition per county
